name: Full Stack Developer Portfolio
description: A personal portfolio website showcasing projects, skills, and experience of a full-stack developer.
prompt: Create a professional portfolio website for a full-stack developer named John Doe. It should include sections for Home/Hero, About Me, Skills (categorized), Projects (with details and links), Experience (timeline format), and a Contact section. The design should be modern, clean, and responsive, using a dark theme with a vibrant accent color (e.g., teal or bright blue). Ensure smooth scrolling navigation and professional typography.
